he: לאחר הבידוק הביטחוני בכניסה הראשית, פנו ימינה לכיוון בניין אם וילד.
המשיכו לפי השילוט בתוך בניין אם וילד.
en: After security at the main hospital entrance, turn right toward the Mother and Child Building.
Continue by following the signs inside the Mother and Child Building.
ar: بعد التفتيش الأمني عند المدخل الرئيسي للمستشفى، انعطف يميناً باتجاه مبنى الأم والطفل.
تابع باتباع اللافتات داخل مبنى الأم والطفل.

routingNotes.MAIN-MC: Official Hadassah directions explicitly support the MAIN -> MC public instruction after security. The page has internally inconsistent Mother and Child entrance hours; verify current after-hours access at security.
routingNotes.cross-building: No other public cross-building route is encoded. Official AED map references a technical-floor junction between Davidson, Old and Mother/Child buildings, but this is NOT proof of public access. Do not route through it.
routingNotes.MC-MAIN: Reverse MC -> MAIN directions have not been independently documented as a public route and are not encoded.
